responsibility: Provides rustc’s LLVM Kernel Control Flow Integrity support by defining the public KCFI module API and exposing the type-id entry points, while the nested `typeid` layer derives KCFI function and instance identifiers from the shared CFI Itanium ABI type encoding, applies KCFI-specific option handling such as reify-shim adjustments, and hashes the result into the 32-bit metadata format required by LLVM KCFI.
